entries.name: Dreaming Nae'dra
entries.unlock: Dreaming Nae'dra is learned from Scale of the Prismatic Whiskerfish. Obtaining this item requires Fishing in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope. You can do it on any difficulty, even LFR and can be done also after the raid is cleared. It is a second wing for LFR: Molten Incursion, if you are in a group I advise you first clear it with the group then go back to fish. Just go to Wellspring Artium and start fishing in the large pool until you get 10 Slumbering Moonfish. Then go to the Pit of Volcoross and fish in lava until you get 10 Awakening Sunfish. Go back to the Wellspring Artium and throw all the fish to the big pool, it should spawn a pool where you fish Xena, the Whimsical Whiskerfish from. Toss it back into the water and you get the Scale. It might take some time to get all the fish when your Dragon Isles Fishing is low.

entries.name: Lunarwing
entries.unlock: Archdruid's Lunarwing Form is rewarded from the quest You Can't Take the Sky from Me. It replaces your normal Flight Form. If you want to go back to normal version or go back again to Lunarwing just visit a barbershop. It's color depends on your character's race. This form allows you to carry a passenger on your back.

refs.name: You Can't Take the Sky from Me

entries.name: Scornwing
entries.unlock: Feldruid's Scornwing Form is rewarded from the achievement Timerunner: Druid which requires to level a Druid to level 80 during Legion: Remix event. It also can be purchased from Grandmaster Jakkus for 20000 currency 3252. It replaces your normal Flight Form. If you want to go back to normal version or go back again to Lunarwing just visit a barbershop. There is one color option for all races. This form allows you to carry a passenger on your back. This form will be unobtainable after Legion: Remix ends
